title: Japanese Pan Noodles
description: Toss udon noodles in a pan of broccoli, pepper, and zucchini stir-fry, coated with chili-garlic sauce to make this easy Japanese-style dish.
ingredients: 0.5 teaspoon sesame oil, divided, or to taste
0.5 green bell pepper, cut into matchsticks
2 small carrots, cut into matchsticks, or to taste

steps.text: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook udon in boiling water, stirring occasionally, until noodles are tender yet firm to the bite, 10 to 12 minutes. Drain and rinse with cold water. Stir in a few drops of sesame oil.

Heat the remaining sesame oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Cook broccoli until bright green and still crunchy, about 5 minutes. Add green bell pepper and carrots; cook and stir until slightly softened, about 2 minutes. Add zucchini; cook until slightly softened, about 2 minutes more. Add soy sauce, mirin, chili-garlic sauce, and ginger; stir to combine. Mix in the noodles; cook and stir until noodles absorb some of the sauce, 1 to 2 minutes more.
